northStar: risk-adjusted cleared contribution profit per founder minute
truthRule: External skills, plugins, runtimes, gateways, memories, scanners, research tools, and orchestrators are replaceable suppliers beneath current repository canon and durable external evidence. Capability never creates authority.

entries.name: Find Skills
entries.role: Discover candidate agent skills for missing capabilities.
entries.uberbondUse: Candidate-generation front end for the existing Automation Capability Acquisition Loop.
notes: Popularity and install count are ranking signals only.
Every candidate must be deduped and reviewed for license, security, data and external-effect risk before activation.

entries.name: Claude Code Setup
entries.role: Read-only codebase auditor recommending MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents and slash commands.
entries.uberbondUse: Periodic capability-gap and Claude Code automation audit; recommendations are reconciled against canonical modules.
notes: Official Anthropic plugin method adapted project-locally so the audit capability is available even before marketplace activation.
Read-only recommendation does not authorize installation or consequenceful actions.

entries.name: Task Observer
entries.role: Observe corrections, repeated manual work and skill gaps; propose skill improvements.
entries.uberbondUse: Self-improvement observation layer for the AI employee skill library.
notes: Do not silently mutate canonical skills or prompts.
Observation logs must exclude secrets and unnecessary private data.
Preserve attribution to Eoghan Henn / rebelytics.com when adapting or redistributing.

entries.name: Claude-Mem
entries.role: Persistent compressed working memory for Claude Code sessions.
entries.uberbondUse: Developer-session memory cache below repository-native brain and memory hierarchy.
notes: May not override npm run brain, current main, Master Memory, current state, handoff or durable external receipts.
Treat plugin summaries as advisory working memory.
Review data-retention and local-service behavior before using sensitive inputs.

entries.name: Headroom
entries.role: Context compression, retrieval and token/cost optimization through proxy, SDK or MCP.
entries.uberbondUse: Compress high-volume logs/tool outputs while preserving recoverable authoritative originals.
notes: Never make compressed text the sole copy of canon, receipts, exact diffs, legal evidence, security evidence or customer acceptance.
Measure quality/cost benefit against an uncompressed baseline.
Prefer reversible retrieval/passthrough for exact evidence.

entries.name: OmniRoute
entries.role: Model/provider gateway with routing, fallback, quota awareness, MCP/A2A and optimization mechanisms.
entries.uberbondUse: Optional execution supplier and routing-pattern donor beneath UberBond model admission/routing contracts.
notes: Do not allow a gateway to become a second policy brain.
Provider/model identity and fallback must remain observable.
Credentials remain outside the repository.
Routing/fallback may not weaken evidence, privacy, safety or capability requirements.

entries.name: Strix
entries.role: Autonomous application security testing and proof-backed vulnerability verification.
entries.uberbondUse: Bounded security worker for local/test/preview or explicitly authorized UberBond-owned targets.
notes: Never scan or exploit unrelated third parties.
Default to local/test/preview scope.
No credential theft, persistence or destructive action.
Findings require verification before canonical defect promotion.

entries.name: Agent Reach
entries.role: Cross-platform public/social/niche web research and diagnostics.
entries.uberbondUse: Prometheus/world-sensing supplier for software scouting, buyer-language research, opportunity discovery and competitor research.
notes: No CAPTCHA bypass, fingerprint spoofing, access-block evasion or prohibited scraping.
No private-account/cookie/session use without exact separate authorization and policy review.
No inferred private contact information.
Preserve source provenance and distinguish reachability from permission.

entries.name: Fable Orchestrator
entries.role: Planner/adjudicator separation, bounded task-graph construction, callable-worker validation and evidence-based integration.
entries.uberbondUse: Reference baseline for UberBond's provider-neutral FABLE_GRAPH orchestration protocol across ChatGPT mission control, Claude Code and Codex-style runtimes.
notes: The upstream repository is a mechanism donor and optional local runtime, not a new company brain.
Do not copy its user-specific local paths or assume GPT-5.6 Luna / DeepSeek routes are callable in another host.
Live planner use requires observable planner identity plus a verified callable-worker menu.
Never place credentials or private secrets in orchestration packets.

entries.name: Metaswarm
entries.role: Recursive multi-agent orchestration, independent adversarial review, durable task state, selective knowledge priming and PR lifecycle donor.
entries.uberbondUse: Mechanism donor for SWARM / RECURSIVE_SWARM operation without importing a second task-truth or memory authority.
notes: Do not make BEADS or the full Metaswarm plugin a second canonical task/memory system without a separate benchmark and migration case.
Adopt recursive orchestration only with depth/iteration caps and authority attenuation.
Independent verification and cross-model review are evidence mechanisms, not authority.

entries.name: Superpowers
entries.role: Test-driven development, systematic debugging, behavioral verification, worktree isolation, planning and subagent review methodology.
entries.uberbondUse: Engineering-discipline donor strengthening Claude/Codex execution beneath existing UberBond test, Mutation War and no-amputation law.
notes: Behavioral falsifiability outranks grep/text-presence test theater.
UberBond's current Mutation War, payment truth, consequence gates and repository memory win any methodological conflict.
Full plugin installation is optional per host and is not required for UberBond truth.

assimilationOrder: Find Skills and Claude Code Setup remain project-local discovery/audit suppliers.
Task Observer remains the recommendation-only skill-improvement observer.
Claude-Mem, Headroom and OmniRoute remain optional bounded developer/runtime suppliers.
Strix and Agent Reach remain bounded security/research suppliers under explicit source/target rules.

Fable Orchestrator supplies the current planner/adjudicator and bounded-graph reference baseline through UberBond-native Claude and Codex project skills; live upstream planner execution is separately runtime-evidence gated.
Metaswarm contributes recursive orchestration, adversarial review and durable coordination mechanisms without becoming a second task-truth system.
Superpowers contributes TDD, debugging, behavioral verification, worktree and subagent-review discipline without becoming a second engineering constitution.
Gamechanger Mesh plus the orchestration frontier continuously search for Fable N+1 challengers and promote only after evidence-backed comparison.
